superseded_reason: The first aggregate build stopped because the predeclared zero-vehicle group had n=0. No result artifact was written and no replacement contrast was selected.
paper_claim: Carr-S aggregate outcomes and process trajectories will be compared with estimand-aligned respondent-sample references and executable constraints, without treating the survey as weighted population truth.

order_to_departure_delay.estimand: hours from first reported mandatory or voluntary evacuation order to reported departure
order_to_departure_delay.main: Q9.1 evacuees with both timestamps, nonnegative temporal order, and no order-response contradiction
order_to_departure_delay.sensitivity: affirmative-order priority, retaining otherwise valid order-response contradictions

warning_channels.estimand: multi-select channel prevalence among reported order recipients
warning_channels.main: all finished warned respondents excluding the 15 order-response contradictions

contrasts: zero vehicles minus one or more vehicles
subgroup_evacuation_gaps.missingness: complete cases within each contrast; no imputation

required_before_claim: separate real-model Carr-S full-condition runs without controlled initial plans
blinded human or expert ratings with agreement

claim_boundary: The aggregate reference build verifies data transformations and freezes estimands. Empirical compatibility is not established until independently generated real-model Carr-S runs and blinded ratings are analyzed.
